lines.beaver: 내일 결혼식에 뭐 입지? 옷이 너무 많아.
lines.beaver_en: What should I wear to the wedding tomorrow? I have too many clothes.
lines.beaver_roman: naeil gyeolhonsige mwo ipji? osi neomu mana.
lines.en: If it's a wedding, I hope your attire is neat.

lines.beaver: 유행은 따라야 하지 않아? 이 옷 요즘 유행이야.
lines.beaver_en: Shouldn't I follow trends? This is in style now.
lines.beaver_roman: yuhaengeun ttaraya haji ana? i ot yojeum yuhaengiya.
lines.learner: 유행보다 몸에 맞는 옷이 중요해. 맞춤이면 더 좋고.
lines.en: Fit matters more than trends. Custom-made is even better.
lines.roman: yuhaengboda mome manneun osi jungyohae. matchumimyeon deo joko.

lines.learner: 소재가 제일 중요해. 땀이 잘 마르는 게 좋아.
lines.en: The material matters most. Quick-drying is good.
lines.roman: sojaega jeil jungyohae. ttami jal mareuneun ge joa.

lines.beaver_en: How about this shirt? Is it a bit clunky?
lines.learner: 깃이 너무 커. 좀 더 작으면 좋겠어.
lines.en: The collar is too big. I'd like it a bit smaller.
lines.roman: gisi neomu keo. jom deo jageumyeon jokesseo.

lines.beaver: 이 얇은 코트는? 내일 추울 것 같은데.
lines.beaver_en: What about this thin coat? It might be cold tomorrow.
lines.beaver_roman: i yalbeun koteuneun? naeil chuul geot gateunde.
lines.learner: 추우면 안에 옷을 껴입는 게 나아.
lines.en: If it's cold, it's better to layer underneath.
lines.roman: chuumyeon ane oseul kkyeoimneun ge naa.

lines.beaver: 이 치마는 어때? 옷자락이 길어서 멋있지?
lines.beaver_en: How about this skirt? The long hem looks nice, right?
lines.beaver_roman: i chimaneun eottae? otjaragi gireoseo meositji?
lines.en: I hope the hem doesn't touch the floor.

lines.beaver_en: What shoes would be good? Dress shoes?
lines.learner: 밑창이 미끄럽지 않은 걸로 신었으면 해.
lines.en: I hope you wear ones with non-slip soles.
lines.roman: mitchangi mikkeureopji aneun geollo sineosseumyeon hae.

lines.beaver_en: Grandma says she only wore rubber shoes back then.
lines.en: Rubber shoes! Clothing life was clearly different then.

lines.beaver: 옷차림에 대해 더 말해 줄래? 장신구는?
lines.beaver_en: Tell me more about outfits? What about accessories?
lines.beaver_roman: otcharime daehae deo malhae jullae? jangsinguneun?
lines.learner: 장신구는 하나만 해. 그게 더 멋스러워.
lines.en: Wear just one accessory. That's more stylish.
lines.roman: jangsinguneun hanaman hae. geuge deo meotseureowo.

lines.beaver: 고마워. 덕분에 내일 옷 다 골랐어!
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. Thanks to you, I picked my outfit!
lines.beaver_roman: gomawo. deokbune naeil ot da gollasseo!
lines.learner: 잘됐다. 내일 즐거운 하루가 됐으면 해!
lines.en: Great. I hope you have a fun day tomorrow!
lines.roman: jaldwaetda. naeil jeulgeoun haruga dwaesseumyeon hae!
